# D-0253 builder A allowlist: equivalent mutants only (MUTATOR at file.go:line:col | reason)
ARITHMETIC_BASE at options.go:108:28 | `2*len(d4Options)` in make([]string, 0, cap) is only a capacity hint; a smaller capacity makes append grow the slice, so the returned elements and every observable result are identical
ARITHMETIC_BASE at options.go:108:43 | `+2` in the same make() capacity hint; any non-negative capacity (2/len+2, 2*len-2) yields the same slice contents, only the allocation size differs, which no behavioural test can observe
